core_contribution.summary: Turn the imported corpus from mostly logged context into safe, accountable README value.

acceptance_checks_passed: A serial representative transaction proves the knowledge contract before disjoint repository refresh workers fan out across the portfolio
Every processable Python, .NET, Java, C++, TypeScript, Rust, and Go repository has a current knowledge disposition; absence is explicit and does not become invented prose
Only committed upstream mechanism blobs are imported; generated benchmark bytes are never imported as mechanism or fact authority and require the separate stable-synchronization contract
The local knowledge generator reproduces adopted facts from pinned product sources with Aspose.org absent
Upstream output is never accepted as factual without repository corroboration and local schema validation
The generated benchmark tree reaches BENCHMARK_PROFILE_FROZEN only after two identical inventories, receipt and denominator reconciliation, and a fresh audit
The complete latest canonical candidate tree is inventoried even when its own aggregate audit omits a repository or a receipt
Missing, stale, skipped, mutating, incompletely synchronized, or failing benchmark proof remains diagnostic and cannot lower local acceptance
Every discovered check is accounted for, but only independently qualified applicable checks become blocking
Upstream false positives, defects, and workflow-specific assumptions are adapted, quarantined, or rejected
A current-source contradiction or stub cannot authorize a positive capability/format claim
One verified item cannot promote an unverified sibling
Every selected imported claim either binds exact candidate spans or a typed omission reason
Changing an applicable accepted knowledge item changes useful bytes or an explicit disposition
